title: The Census in the Wilderness of Sinai
image_prompt: First day of the second month in the Sinai wilderness: Moses and Aaron seated under a linen council pavilion with parchment scrolls, recording the honorable leaders and families of the twelve tribes of Israel in a dignified national census under bright morning sunlight.

title: The Levites Appointed Over the Sanctuary
image_prompt: Courtyard perimeter of the golden Tabernacle: faithful Levites dressed in clean white linen tunics and turbans, standing as dedicated holy guardians around the four sides of the sacred enclosure, preserving the holiness of the house of the Lord.

title: The Camp of Judah on the East
image_prompt: Eastern sunrise over the desert plain: Prince Nahshon and the mighty tribe of Judah pitching orderly rows of white linen tents under a majestic embroidered banner fluttering in the dawn breeze, facing the golden entrance of the Tabernacle toward the sunrise.

title: The Majestic Order of the Four Encampments
image_prompt: Grand bird's-eye panoramic view: the vast camp of Israel arranged in perfect geometric symmetry—thousands of tents organized in four grand divisions around the central glowing Tabernacle, each division beneath its distinct colorful tribal standard under clear blue desert skies.

title: The Levites Dedicated to God
image_prompt: Tabernacle entrance: Moses presenting the assembly of Levite men before High Priest Aaron, dedicating the entire tribe to the lifelong sacred service of the sanctuary on behalf of the children of Israel.

title: The Encampments of the Three Levite Clans
image_prompt: Inner perimeter around the Tabernacle court: the Gershonites, Kohathites, and Merarites pitching their tents in peaceful devotion to the west, south, and north, while Moses and Aaron dwell before the eastern gate under the gentle shade of acacia trees.

title: Veiling the Holy Vessels for the Journey
image_prompt: Reverent interior sanctuary: Aaron and his sons carefully covering the Ark of the Covenant with the magnificent embroidered veil, topped with protective badger skins and a pure royal blue linen cloth, before the poles are set in place for travel.

title: Transporting the Curtains and Pillars
image_prompt: Courtyard of the Tabernacle: strong Levites of Gershon and Merari carefully rolling the embroidered tapestries and loading heavy gold-overlaid acacia boards and solid bronze sockets onto sturdy travel wagons, operating in perfect harmony.

title: Restitution and Honesty in the Camp
image_prompt: Village stone courtyard: two Hebrew neighbors dressed in modest linen tunics sharing a warm handshake of reconciliation, as one joyfully restores borrowed property and bright silver shekels with a fifth part added, maintaining peace and truth.

title: The Sacred Prayer of Innocence and Peace
image_prompt: Tabernacle gate: a dignified, modestly veiled Hebrew woman standing peacefully beside an altar of the Lord with an offering of barley meal in an earthen vessel, receiving a gentle priest's blessing of divine vindication, purity, and family peace under soft morning skies.

title: The Vow of the Consecrated Nazirite
image_prompt: Quiet rocky hill overlooking the camp: a devout young Hebrew man with long, natural uncut hair and a simple white wool mantle, lifting his hands in solemn prayer of total dedication and spiritual separation unto the Lord, refusing the wine of the earth.

title: The Aaronic Priestly Benediction
image_prompt: High Priest Aaron standing on the stone terrace of the Tabernacle in holy vestments, raising both hands wide over the vast reverent assembly of Israel, bestowing the eternal blessing of peace as golden divine light shines upon the smiling faces of the congregation.

title: The Offerings of the Covered Wagons
image_prompt: Desert plain outside the sanctuary: twelve tribal princes presenting six heavy, covered travel wagons and twelve strong oxen to Moses and the Levites, a generous gift of transport for the wilderness journey.

title: The Dedication Vessels of the Princes
image_prompt: Sanctuary courtyard: a noble tribal prince presenting a gleaming heavy silver charger of 130 shekels, a silver bowl filled with fine flour mingled with oil, and a solid golden spoon filled with fragrant white incense to the welcoming priests.

title: The Voice Speaking from the Mercy Seat
image_prompt: Intimate holy scene inside the Most Holy Place: Moses standing in profound awe with bowed head and hand on heart, listening in sacred silence as the gentle, radiant voice of God speaks audibly from between the two golden Cherubim above the Mercy Seat.

title: The Seven Lamps of the Menorah
image_prompt: Interior Holy Place: High Priest Aaron carefully lighting the seven golden oil lamps of the Menorah with a taper, arranging the flames so their warm amber light radiates forward across the pure gold shaft and almond blossom carvings.

title: The Cleansing of the Levites
image_prompt: Assembly courtyard: Levite men clad in immaculate white linen standing before the altar as Moses sprinkles water of purification over them, while elders of Israel place their hands upon them in a sacred national wave offering of dedication.

title: The Wilderness Passover in Sinai
image_prompt: Nighttime in the Sinai desert: Hebrew families gathered quietly inside their tents sharing the sacred memorial meal of roasted lamb and unleavened bread, celebrating the second anniversary of the Exodus under a canopy of brilliant desert stars.

title: The Pillar of Cloud by Day and Fire by Night
image_prompt: Dual-aspect atmospheric masterpiece: a towering, supernatural Pillar of Cloud sheltering the golden Tabernacle under midday desert heat, transitioning to a glowing, radiant Pillar of Fire illuminating the camp of Israel through the dark desert night.

title: The Two Silver Trumpets
image_prompt: Sanctuary terrace at sunrise: two Levite priests in white vestments lifting long, slender hammered silver trumpets to their lips, blowing clear, resounding blasts across the desert valley to summon the princes and call the camp to march.

title: The Cloud Lifts and Judah Leads the March
image_prompt: Twentieth day of the second month: the glorious Pillar of Cloud lifting high above the Tabernacle into the blue heavens; the standard of Judah with the tribe's banners marching forward across the desert sand at the head of the great caravan.

title: The Orderly March with the Holy Vessels
image_prompt: Procession through the desert canyon: the Kohathites walking in solemn cadence carrying the veiled Ark of the Covenant and golden sanctuary furniture on poles, surrounded by marching tribal hosts with fluttering standards in perfect harmony.

title: Moses Invites Hobab on the Journey
image_prompt: Roadside desert halt: Moses smiling warmly with hand extended to his brother-in-law Hobab the Midianite, welcoming him with genuine brotherhood to journey together toward the promised inheritance: 'Come thou with us, and we will do thee good.'

title: Rise Up, O Lord!
image_prompt: Climactic desert departure: Moses standing upon a desert ridge raising his wooden staff toward the open horizon as the golden Ark of the Covenant journeys ahead, speaking the triumphant prayer of faith: 'Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered!'
